Tap a category at the top to filter, or use the search bar to find a vibe. See one you love? Tap it to open the full style. 👇

title: Uploading your photos
text: 🤳 Lesson: Your uploads matter MOST The AI learns your face from the selfies you upload. Better selfies = better results. ✅ Clear, well-lit face ✅ A few different angles ✅ No sunglasses, no heavy filters ❌ Blurry or dark photos ❌ Group photos Give the AI good material and it rewards you. 🔥

title: Choosing your package
text: 📦 Lesson: Picking your package Most styles let you choose how many images you want — usually 1, 5, or 10. • Just need one clean shot? Grab the single. • Want a full set for your feed? The 5 or 10 pack gives variety — different poses and angles. More images = more looks to post all week. 📅

title: After you order
text: ⏳ Lesson: After you place your order Once you pay, the AI gets to work creating your photos one by one. You'll watch them appear as each finishes. If one image doesn't come out right, you can retry just that image — no stress. When they're ready, download them straight to your phone. 📲

title: Look natural, not AI
text: 💎 Gem of the day: Look natural, not 'AI' Want results people can't tell are AI? Three secrets: 1️⃣ Upload sharp, high-quality selfies 2️⃣ Include a couple of neutral (non-smiling) shots AND one smiling 3️⃣ Pick a style that matches your real vibe The better your inputs, the more the output looks like the real, premium you. 👑

title: Will it look like me
text: 🤔 'But will it actually look like ME?' Fair question. Honest answer: it depends on what you give it. Upload three blurry photos from 2019 and you'll get a stranger. Upload clear, well-lit selfies from a few angles — one neutral, one smiling — and people who know you won't be able to tell how it was made. The AI doesn't invent your face. It works from the one you give it. So give it a good one. 💎 Try it today and judge for yourself 👉 www.aluxartandframes.shop
